scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration corroborates but is not a proof of the all-depth theorems. The normal approximation uses a published independent-summand Berry--Esseen constant. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The minimum size is relative to finite outward rooted trees with immediate-child access and ordinary non-counting modal formulas. General transition systems may be smaller by sharing states; no graded, converse, or fixpoint operators are included. Full weighted spectra grow rapidly and prior-literature coverage cannot guarantee priority.
title: Exact minimal witness-size spectra and a Gaussian law for finite-depth modal tree types
